title: Ben Webster, Bob Dorsey and the three B's argument
summary: Comedian Pigmeat asked Caldwell to settle an argument among Ben Webster, Bob Dorsey and Bob Carroll about Hawk.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong

blocks.x: Yeah, saxophone. He came there with -- with Hawk -- with Horace, with --
No, he came there with Fletcher and his brother brought him here, Horace Henderson.
Oh, Horace took some band members.
That's right. He booked him here.
Nat Towles -- no, Ernie Fields or something or other.

No, he was a good tenor player. Now, all around the same size, like Ben Webster. So one day I'm going up to the Apollo Theater, said, I'll stop at the bar and talk with the fellows in the performance. So I saw all this crowd stopping by (unintelligible) near the back end of the Apollo Theater

on 126th towards Sixth Street. So (unintelligible) said, say, Hap, one of the comedians Pigmeat said, come here. I said, hey, what do you say, (unintelligible). Why don't you go (unintelligible) them cats are? I said, about what? Who is it? Said, them three old B's. We called them the three B's -- Bob Dorsey, Ben Webster and --- I said, who? He said, the three B's up there. I said, oh, Lord, said, I ain't going to get in this.

Probably about something, music or something. They got to arguing and been drinking, you know. Well, Wesley was -- wanted to get in a fight, but they were how musicians are, just, you know, it was just a joke. So I couldn't duck it. So when Ben Webster and them saw me and Bob Carroll, hey, Happy, Happy Caldwell, (unintelligible) straighten that out right now. Happy, come here. I said, oh, boy.

I said, what's -- what's wrong. Hap, Carroll -- this cat here is so and so and so and so. Then he got you to refresh your memory, go back because I was there before them fellows ever came to New York, talking about Hawk. So he said, if any man know Hawk. Ben said, it would be you. Said, now, we just keep quiet, just ask one question. That's it. What he said -- we'll take it. So I asked the question. It was right.
So Ben said, that's all I want to know. Bob Carroll said, I told you, you big bum, you.
Talking to Bob Dorsey (unintelligible). He was -- he was -- he wanted fight the policeman wasn't trying to (unintelligible), but Bob was funny, and he had a good education.
